summary: @or-sdk/library preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes a heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle whose contents are heavily obfuscated (rotating string-array decoder, hex-named identifiers, character-code indirection). The loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated using obfuscator.io-style transforms (hex identifiers such as `_0x19328d`, string-map indirection over literal argument values). The package is advertised as a REST-SDK/Library, a purpose that has no legitimate need to install the Bun runtime or execute a `math_init.js` payload during `npm install`; the executed bytes are opaque and cannot be tied to any documented functionality of the SDK. Using an alternate JS runtime to execute obfuscated bundled code at install time bypasses Node-focused scanners and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
